claim: Sentosa's three southern beaches — Siloso, Palawan and Tanjong — are artificial, reclaimed using sand bought from Indonesia and Malaysia.
quote: These beaches are artificial, reclaimed using sand bought from Indonesia and Malaysia.

claim: Palawan Beach is linked by a wooden suspension bridge to a small islet billed as the Southernmost Point of Continental Asia, with twin viewing towers.
Wave House Sentosa, the FlowRider/FlowBarrel surf venue on Siloso Beach, is listed as CLOSED on Time Out's Singapore directory.
Tanjong Beach Club reopened after a four-month facelift with a new wood-fired menu and warmer palette, replacing its earlier pristine-white look after 15 years.
quote: Once known for its pristine white look, Tanjong Beach Club has since swapped that up for warmer, more vibrant shades that instantly modernises the 15-year-old space.

claim: Tanjong Beach Club programmes the chill/luxe end of Sentosa: wood-fired grill, daybeds, sunset cocktails plus Tanjong Rose Club brunch and GAIAVIP house/techno DJ series.
quote: where beach culture, community and soulful experiences collide

claim: Smoke & Mirrors, the rooftop cocktail bar atop National Gallery Singapore, served its last night on 15 March 2025 after nine years when its lease ended.
quote: National Gallery S'pore bar Smoke & Mirrors closing down on Mar. 15 after 9 years

claim: Smoke & Mirrors' programme paired a Padang skyline view with art-driven cocktails — its 'Real Art of Drinking' menus mimicked gallery artworks, the latest being 12 drinks built around a painter's-palette colour wheel.
quote: The current menu showcases 12 cocktails inspired by painter's palette colours

claim: Time Out ranked Smoke & Mirrors the world's #2 rooftop bar in 2024, its highest international accolade before the closure.
quote: Smoke & Mirrors comes in second among the best rooftop bars in the world
